svg.title: weightpatch process: two directories to one patch, then apply, revert and screen
svg.desc: diff compares a base and an edited safetensors directory as raw words and writes a sparse .wpatch with bounding-box slices and both digests; apply and revert replay or undo the slices with pre-image and post-image checks; screen maps the same patch onto a single-file GGUF by architecture and name map, reversing the ne order, and reports kept, missing or reshaped.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace
